summary: CubeSmart and CubeSmart, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Facility, consisting of a $1 billion unsecured revolving facility maturing June 24, 2030, replacing the prior $850 million facility. Pricing is based on credit ratings and leverage, currently SOFR plus 0.775% with a 0.15% facility fee. Initial proceeds repaid previous borrowings. This is a routine refinancing of a credit agreement, not a special situation.
